# F4: Fit and finish, goal-history

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/4-goal-history.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

fit and finish, goal-history (per-area reports, 4 Nov). The goal page ([Goal]), the History layout ([Hist]) and the check-in step's chart ([Check-in 3]).

## Where it looks

- 1280 × 800, as rhea, at `/goals/ns-lead`
- 390 × 844, as rhea, at `'/goals/ns-lead', true`
- 360 × 740, as daniel, at `'/goals/lead-mq', true`
- 1440 × 900, as amara, at `/goals/env-search`
- 1280 × 800, as tariq, at `/goals/lead-review`
- 1280 × 800, as amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history`
- 768 × 1024, as amara, at `'/goals?scope=all&view=history', true`
- 1440 × 700, as amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly`
- 1280 × 800, as amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly&weeks=year`
- 390 × 844, as amara, at `'/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly', true`
- 360 × 740, as amara, at `'/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly&weeks=year', true`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day.
